page.title: Approvals
page.descriptionBefore: Calls that would go over a spend cap, or that your rules say to ask about, wait here. An approval lets that exact call run once. Set caps on the
page.missing: That request is not in this list. It may be older, or filtered out.
page.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting. When an agent asks to spend over a cap, the request shows up here and in the sidebar.
page.footerNote: An approval covers only the call it was asked for, with the same arguments, and only once. Requests nobody answers expire. Amounts are estimates.
